scenes.text: Material 3 Expressive has landed in Jetpack Compose. But ask your AI agent to use it, and things go wrong.
It invents APIs. It adds opt-ins you don't need. And it writes code your material3 version can't even compile.
Meet the M3 Expressive skill. One install, and Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Copilot know Material 3 Expressive for real.
It knows which Expressive APIs are stable in material3 one point five, which still need an opt-in, and what has been deprecated.
Button groups. FAB menus. Floating toolbars. Wavy progress. Every Expressive component, with code that's ready to use.
All thirty-five Material shapes, smooth shape morphing, and spring motion with the real values from the library.
It knows the design rules too. Selection that changes shape, contrast for the main action, and one hero moment, not ten.
And every Kotlin sample it reads is compiled in CI. So your agent writes code that builds, the first time.
Install it in one command. It's free and open source. Find it at expressive dot sanikant dot dev.
